bring it to me before the meeting

quests.title: Turf Money, East Richmond

steps.label: $78, however you like, I am not asking
put it in my hand, not the safe

quests.title: The East Richmond Membership Count
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. Our books say 41 members at East Richmond and I would bet the bar takings that half of them are dead or moved to Queensland. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: stand at the side door where the list is kept
the board with the names still on it

quests.title: Closing Time Rumour, East Richmond
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. Since first light somebody has been going round the East Richmond greens telling the barefoot bowlers we are shutting, and we are not shutting. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: whoever is doing the telling
and take the bar money off them while you are there

quests.title: Behind the Bar at East Richmond
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: get one into you first, seriously
round the back where the cellar door is
whatever is in there, before I lose my nerve

quests.title: The Old Greenkeeper, East Richmond

steps.label: find him and hear him out
come back and tell me what he said
